summary: Issue #406 fix is fully implemented per the saved plan. _run_pre_push_validation_fix_pass now re-reads HEAD on the not-committed path: when HEAD advanced past fix_start_head (agent self-commit, clean tree) it logs monitor.pre_push_validation_fix_self_commit_detected, runs the shared cleanup against the advanced head, and returns committed=True (no reset --hard fix_start_head), so the caller re-validates the advanced head; when HEAD did not advance (or is None) it preserves the existing rollback. The committed-head cleanup is extracted into the shared helper _cleanup_committed_pre_push_validation_fix_pass reused by both paths. Rollback is unchanged for agent-exception, ComposeExecCleanupError, and commit-exception paths. Tests match the plan: new test_pre_push_validation_fix_pass_detects_agent_self_commit, parametrized test_..._genuine_no_commit_still_rolls_back (fix_start and None re-read), and test_..._self_commit_cleanup_failure_surfaces_reason; the existing dirty-worktree commit-path test stays green; commit-False existing tests were adjusted with the extra HEAD re-read queue entry. No new reason codes, schema, or migration changes, matching the documented non-goals.
